translations.literal: Extreme swiftness then cold as if; extreme leisure then warm as if; reaching mid, rain and clear weather's qi intersect—the number of nature.
translations.idiomatic: Extreme swiftness brings cold as it were; extreme leisure brings warmth as it were; at midpoint the qi of rain and clear weather intersect—the way of nature.

sentences.zh: 焯術於春分前一日最急，後一日最舒；

translations.literal: Chuo's method: one day before the spring equinox swiftest, one day after most leisurely;
translations.idiomatic: Chuo's method made one day before the spring equinox swiftest and one day after most leisurely;

sentences.zh: 秋分前一日最舒，後一日最急。

translations.literal: one day before the autumn equinox most leisurely, one day after swiftest.
translations.idiomatic: one day before the autumn equinox most leisurely and one day after swiftest.

sentences.zh: 舒急同于二至，而中間一日平行。

translations.literal: Leisure and swiftness match the two extremes, while the middle day moves uniformly.
translations.idiomatic: Leisure and swiftness match the two solstices, while the middle day moves uniformly.

sentences.zh: 其說非是。

translations.literal: Its theory is not correct.
translations.idiomatic: That theory is incorrect.

sentences.zh: 當以二十四氣晷景，考日躔盈縮而密於加時。

translations.literal: One ought to examine the twenty-four qi gnomon shadows, verifying solar lodge expansion and contraction more closely than added times.
translations.idiomatic: One should examine the twenty-four qi gnomon shadows, verifying solar lodge expansion and contraction more closely than added times.

sentences.zh: 其九九道議曰：

translations.literal: Its ninth, the discourse on the nine paths, says:
translations.idiomatic: The ninth section, the discourse on the nine paths, states:

sentences.zh: 洪範傳云：「日有中道，月有九行。

translations.literal: The Hongfan commentary says: 'The sun has a middle path; the moon has nine courses.
translations.idiomatic: The Hongfan commentary says: 'The sun has a middle path; the moon has nine courses.

sentences.zh: 」中道，謂黃道也。

translations.literal: ' The middle path means the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: ' The middle path means the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 九行者，青道二，出黃道東；

translations.literal: The nine courses: the Green Path two, issuing east of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: The nine courses are: the Green Path, two, issuing east of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 朱道二，出黃道南；

translations.literal: the Vermilion Path two, issuing south of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: the Vermilion Path, two, issuing south of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 白道二，出黃道西；

translations.literal: the White Path two, issuing west of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: the White Path, two, issuing west of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 黑道二，出黃道北。

translations.literal: the Black Path two, issuing north of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: the Black Path, two, issuing north of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 立春、春分，月東從青道；

translations.literal: Establishing spring, spring equinox—the moon eastward follows the Green Path;
translations.idiomatic: At Establishing Spring and the spring equinox the moon eastward follows the Green Path;

sentences.zh: 立夏、夏至，月南從朱道；

translations.literal: establishing summer, summer solstice—the moon southward follows the Vermilion Path;
translations.idiomatic: at Establishing Summer and the summer solstice the moon southward follows the Vermilion Path;

sentences.zh: 立秋、秋分，月西從白道；

translations.literal: establishing autumn, autumn equinox—the moon westward follows the White Path;
translations.idiomatic: at Establishing Autumn and the autumn equinox the moon westward follows the White Path;

sentences.zh: 立冬、冬至，月北從黑道。

translations.literal: establishing winter, winter solstice—the moon northward follows the Black Path.
translations.idiomatic: at Establishing Winter and the winter solstice the moon northward follows the Black Path.

sentences.zh: 漢史官舊事，九道術廢久，劉洪頗採以著遲疾陰陽曆，然本以消息為奇，而術不傳。

translations.literal: Han historiographers' old practice—the nine-path method long abandoned; Liu Hong somewhat adopted it to compose the slow-swift yin-yang calendar, yet its root used message as the marvel, and the method was not transmitted.
translations.idiomatic: Han historiographers' old practice—the nine-path method had long been abandoned; Liu Hong partly adopted it for the slow-swift yin-yang calendar, yet its root used message as the marvel and the method was not transmitted.

sentences.zh: 推陰陽曆交在冬至、夏至，則月行青道、白道，所交則同，而出入之行異。

translations.literal: The yin-yang calendar's nodes at winter and summer solstices—then the moon follows the Green Path and White Path; the nodes are the same, yet the exiting and entering courses differ.
translations.idiomatic: When the yin-yang calendar's nodes fall at the winter and summer solstices, the moon follows the Green and White paths; the nodes coincide, yet the exiting and entering courses differ.

sentences.zh: 故青道至春分之宿，及其所衝，皆在黃道正東；

translations.literal: Therefore the Green Path to the lodges of the spring equinox, and their opposites, all stand due east of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Green Path to the lodges of the spring equinox and their opposites all stand due east of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 白道至秋分之宿，及其所衝，皆在黃道正西。

translations.literal: the White Path to the lodges of the autumn equinox, and their opposites, all stand due west of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: the White Path to the lodges of the autumn equinox and their opposites all stand due west of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 若陰陽曆交在立春、立秋，則月循朱道、黑道，所交則同，而出入之行異。

translations.literal: If the yin-yang calendar's nodes at establishing spring and establishing autumn—then the moon follows the Vermilion Path and Black Path; the nodes are the same, yet the exiting and entering courses differ.
translations.idiomatic: If the yin-yang calendar's nodes fall at Establishing Spring and Establishing Autumn, the moon follows the Vermilion and Black paths; the nodes coincide, yet the exiting and entering courses differ.

sentences.zh: 故朱道至立夏之宿，及其所衝，皆在黃道西南；

translations.literal: Therefore the Vermilion Path to the lodges of establishing summer, and their opposites, all stand southwest of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Vermilion Path to the lodges of Establishing Summer and their opposites all stand southwest of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 黑道至立冬之宿，及其所衝，皆在黃道東北。

translations.literal: the Black Path to the lodges of establishing winter, and their opposites, all stand northeast of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: the Black Path to the lodges of Establishing Winter and their opposites all stand northeast of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 若陰陽曆交在春分、秋分之宿，則月行朱道、黑道，所交則同，而出入之行異。

translations.literal: If the yin-yang calendar's nodes at the lodges of spring and autumn equinox—then the moon follows the Vermilion Path and Black Path; the nodes are the same, yet the exiting and entering courses differ.
translations.idiomatic: If the yin-yang calendar's nodes fall at the lodges of the spring and autumn equinoxes, the moon follows the Vermilion and Black paths; the nodes coincide, yet the exiting and entering courses differ.

sentences.zh: 故朱道至夏至之宿，及其所衝，皆在黃道正南；

translations.literal: Therefore the Vermilion Path to the lodges of the summer solstice, and their opposites, all stand due south of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Vermilion Path to the lodges of the summer solstice and their opposites all stand due south of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 黑道至冬至之宿，及其所衝，皆在黃道正北。

translations.literal: the Black Path to the lodges of the winter solstice, and their opposites, all stand due north of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: the Black Path to the lodges of the winter solstice and their opposites all stand due north of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 若陰陽曆交在立夏、立冬，則月循青道、白道，所交則同，而出入之行異。

translations.literal: If the yin-yang calendar's nodes at establishing summer and establishing winter—then the moon follows the Green Path and White Path; the nodes are the same, yet the exiting and entering courses differ.
translations.idiomatic: If the yin-yang calendar's nodes fall at Establishing Summer and Establishing Winter, the moon follows the Green and White paths; the nodes coincide, yet the exiting and entering courses differ.

sentences.zh: 故青道至立春之宿，及其所衝，皆在黃道東南；

translations.literal: Therefore the Green Path to the lodges of establishing spring, and their opposites, all stand southeast of the Yellow Path;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the Green Path to the lodges of Establishing Spring and their opposites all stand southeast of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 白道至立秋之宿，及其所衝，皆在黃道西北。

translations.literal: the White Path to the lodges of establishing autumn, and their opposites, all stand northwest of the Yellow Path.
translations.idiomatic: the White Path to the lodges of Establishing Autumn and their opposites all stand northwest of the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 其大紀皆兼二道，而實分主八節，合于四正四維。

translations.literal: Its great cycles all combine two paths, yet in fact each chiefly governs one of the eight nodes, matching the four cardinals and four corners.
translations.idiomatic: Its great cycles all combine two paths, yet each in fact chiefly governs one of the eight nodes, matching the four cardinals and four corners.

sentences.zh: 按陰陽曆中終之所交，則月行正當黃道，去交七日，其行九十一度，齊於一象之率，而得八行之中。

translations.literal: When the yin-yang calendar's mid and end nodes meet, the moon's course stands straight on the Yellow Path; seven days from the node it travels ninety-one degrees, matching one image's rate, obtaining the mean of the eight courses.
translations.idiomatic: When the yin-yang calendar's mid and end nodes meet, the moon runs straight on the ecliptic; seven days from the node it travels ninety-one degrees, matching one image's rate—the mean of the eight courses.

sentences.zh: 八行與中道而九，是謂九道。

translations.literal: The eight courses aligned with the middle path make nine—this is called the nine paths.
translations.idiomatic: The eight courses plus the middle path make nine—this is the nine paths.

sentences.zh: 凡八行正於春秋，其去黃道六度，則交在冬夏；

translations.literal: When the eight courses align with spring and autumn, six degrees from the Yellow Path, then the nodes fall at winter and summer;
translations.idiomatic: When the eight courses align with spring and autumn, six degrees from the ecliptic, the nodes fall at winter and summer;

sentences.zh: 正於冬夏，其去黃道六度，則交在春秋。

translations.literal: aligned with winter and summer, six degrees from the Yellow Path, then the nodes fall at spring and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: aligned with winter and summer, six degrees from the ecliptic, the nodes fall at spring and autumn.

sentences.zh: 易九六、七八，迭為終始之象也。

translations.literal: Changes' nine-six and seven-eight alternate as images of ending and beginning.
translations.idiomatic: The Yijing's nine-six and seven-eight lines alternate as images of ending and beginning.

sentences.zh: 乾坤定位，則八行各當其正。

translations.literal: Qian and Kun fixed in position—then the eight courses each stand at their proper place.
translations.idiomatic: With Qian and Kun fixed in position, the eight courses each stand at their proper place.

sentences.zh: 及其寒暑相推，晦朔相易，則在南者變而居北，在東者徙而為西，屈伸、消息之象也。

translations.literal: When cold and heat push each other, and dark and new moons exchange, what was south changes to dwell north, what was east moves to become west—the image of bending-stretching and message.
translations.idiomatic: As cold and heat alternate and new and full moons exchange, what was south shifts north and what was east moves west—the image of waxing, waning, and change.

sentences.zh: 黃道之差，始自春分、秋分，赤道所交前後各五度為限。

translations.literal: The Yellow Path's discrepancy begins from the spring and autumn equinoxes; five degrees before and after where the equator meets is the limit.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic discrepancy begins at the spring and autumn equinoxes; five degrees before and after the equator's crossing is the limit.

sentences.zh: 初，黃道增多赤道二十四分之十二，每限損一，極九限，數終于四，率赤道四十五度而黃道四十八度，至四立之際，一度少強，依平。

translations.literal: At first the Yellow Path exceeds the equator by twelve parts in twenty-four; each limit loses one, reaching nine limits, the number ending at four—rate: equator forty-five degrees, Yellow Path forty-eight degrees; at the four establishments it is one degree slightly strong, then level.
translations.idiomatic: At first the ecliptic exceeds the equator by twelve twenty-fourths; each limit loses one through nine limits, ending at four—forty-five equatorial degrees to forty-eight ecliptic degrees; at the four establishments it is one degree slightly strong, then level.

sentences.zh: 復從四起，初限五度，赤道增多黃道二十四分之四，每限益一，極九限而止，終于十二，率赤道四十五度而黃道四十二度，復得冬、夏至之中矣。

translations.literal: Again from the fourth establishment: initial limit five degrees, equator exceeds Yellow Path by four twenty-fourths; each limit gains one through nine limits, ending at twelve—rate: equator forty-five degrees, Yellow Path forty-two degrees, again reaching winter and summer solstice midpoints.
translations.idiomatic: Again from the fourth establishment: initial limit five degrees, the equator exceeds the ecliptic by four twenty-fourths; each limit gains one through nine limits, ending at twelve—forty-five equatorial degrees to forty-two ecliptic degrees, again reaching the winter and summer solstice midpoints.

sentences.zh: 月道之差，始自交初、交中，黃道所交亦距交前後五度為限。

translations.literal: The moon path's discrepancy begins from node beginning and node mid; five degrees before and after where the Yellow Path meets is also the limit.
translations.idiomatic: The lunar path discrepancy begins at node beginning and node mid; five degrees before and after the ecliptic crossing is likewise the limit.

sentences.zh: 初限，月道增多黃道四十八分之十二，每限損一，極九限而止，數終于四，率黃道四十五度而月道四十六度半，乃一度強，依平。

translations.literal: Initial limit: moon path exceeds Yellow Path by twelve forty-eighths; each limit loses one through nine limits, number ending at four—rate: Yellow Path forty-five degrees, moon path forty-six and a half degrees, one degree slightly strong, then level.
translations.idiomatic: Initial limit: the lunar path exceeds the ecliptic by twelve forty-eighths; each limit loses one through nine limits, ending at four—forty-five ecliptic degrees to forty-six and a half lunar degrees, one degree slightly strong, then level.

sentences.zh: 復從四起，初限五度，月道差少黃道四十八分之四，每限益一，極九限而止，終于十二，率黃道四十五度而月道四十三度半，至陰陽曆二交之半矣。

translations.literal: Again from the fourth establishment: initial limit five degrees, moon path falls short of Yellow Path by four forty-eighths; each limit gains one through nine limits, ending at twelve—rate: Yellow Path forty-five degrees, moon path forty-three and a half degrees, reaching the yin-yang calendar's two nodes' midpoint.
translations.idiomatic: Again from the fourth establishment: initial limit five degrees, the lunar path falls short of the ecliptic by four forty-eighths; each limit gains one through nine limits, ending at twelve—forty-five ecliptic degrees to forty-three and a half lunar degrees, reaching the yin-yang calendar's two nodes' midpoint.

sentences.zh: 凡近交初限增十二分者，至半交末限減十二分，去交四十六度得損益之平率。

translations.literal: Where near node initial limit gains twelve parts, to half-node final limit loses twelve parts—forty-six degrees from the node obtains the level rate of increase and decrease.
translations.idiomatic: Where the near-node initial limit gains twelve parts, to the half-node final limit it loses twelve parts—forty-six degrees from the node gives the level rate of increase and decrease.

sentences.zh: 夫日行與歲差偕遷，月行隨交限而變，遯伏相消，朓朒相補，則九道之數可知矣。

translations.literal: The sun's course shifts with annual precession; the moon's course changes with node limits—retreat and conceal cancel, wax and wane compensate—then the nine paths' numbers can be known.
translations.idiomatic: The sun's course shifts with annual precession and the moon's with node limits; retreat and conceal cancel, wax and wane compensate—then the nine paths' numbers can be known.

sentences.zh: 其月道所交與二分同度，則赤道、黑道近交初限，黃道增二十四分之十二，月道增四十八分之十二。

translations.literal: When the moon path's meeting aligns with the two equinoxes' same degree, then equator and Black Path near node initial limit—Yellow Path gains twelve twenty-fourths, moon path gains twelve forty-eighths.
translations.idiomatic: When the moon path's meeting aligns with the two equinoxes, the equator and Black Path near the node initial limit—the ecliptic gains twelve twenty-fourths and the lunar path twelve forty-eighths.

sentences.zh: 至半交之末，其減亦如之。

translations.literal: To half-node's end, the decrease is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: To the half-node's end, the decrease is likewise.

sentences.zh: 故於九限之際，黃道差三度，月道差一度半，蓋損益之數齊也。

translations.literal: Therefore at the nine limits' juncture, Yellow Path differs three degrees, moon path one and a half degrees—the numbers of increase and decrease align.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore at the nine limits' juncture the ecliptic differs three degrees and the lunar path one and a half—the increase and decrease numbers align.

sentences.zh: 若所交與四立同度，則黃道在損益之中，月道差四十八分之十二。

translations.literal: If the meeting aligns with the four establishments' same degree, then Yellow Path is at increase-decrease midpoint, moon path differs by twelve forty-eighths.
translations.idiomatic: If the meeting aligns with the four establishments, the ecliptic is at the increase-decrease midpoint and the lunar path differs by twelve forty-eighths.

sentences.zh: 月道至損益之中，黃道差二十四分之十二。

translations.literal: Moon path at increase-decrease midpoint, Yellow Path differs by twelve twenty-fourths.
translations.idiomatic: At the lunar path's increase-decrease midpoint, the ecliptic differs by twelve twenty-fourths.

sentences.zh: 於九限之際，黃道差三度，月道差四分度之三，皆朓朒相補也。

translations.literal: At the nine limits' juncture, Yellow Path differs three degrees, moon path three-fourths of a degree—all wax and wane compensate.
translations.idiomatic: At the nine limits' juncture the ecliptic differs three degrees and the lunar path three-fourths of a degree—all wax and wane compensate.

sentences.zh: 若所交與二至同度，則青道、白道近交初限，黃道減二十四分之十二，月道增四十八分之十二。

translations.literal: If the meeting aligns with the two solstices' same degree, then Green Path and White Path near node initial limit—Yellow Path loses twelve twenty-fourths, moon path gains twelve forty-eighths.
translations.idiomatic: If the meeting aligns with the two solstices, the Green and White paths near the node initial limit—the ecliptic loses twelve twenty-fourths and the lunar path gains twelve forty-eighths.

sentences.zh: 至半交之末，黃道增二十四分之十二，月道減四十八分之十二。

translations.literal: To half-node's end, Yellow Path gains twelve twenty-fourths, moon path loses twelve forty-eighths.
translations.idiomatic: To the half-node's end the ecliptic gains twelve twenty-fourths and the lunar path loses twelve forty-eighths.

sentences.zh: 於九限之際，黃道與月道差同，蓋遯伏相消也。

translations.literal: At the nine limits' juncture, Yellow Path and moon path differ alike—retreat and conceal cancel.
translations.idiomatic: At the nine limits' juncture the ecliptic and lunar path differ alike—retreat and conceal cancel.

sentences.zh: 日出入赤道二十四度，月出入黃道六度，相距則四分之一，故於九道之變，以四立為中交。

translations.literal: The sun enters and exits the equator twenty-four degrees; the moon enters and exits the Yellow Path six degrees—the distance is one quarter; therefore in the nine paths' change, the four establishments are the mid-nodes.
translations.idiomatic: The sun enters and exits the equator twenty-four degrees; the moon enters and exits the ecliptic six degrees—a quarter apart; therefore in the nine paths' change the four establishments are the mid-nodes.

sentences.zh: 在二分，增四分之一，而與黃道度相半。

translations.literal: At the two equinoxes, increase one quarter, matching half the Yellow Path degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At the two equinoxes, increase one quarter, matching half the ecliptic degrees.

sentences.zh: 在二至，減四分之一，而與黃道度正均。

translations.literal: At the two solstices, decrease one quarter, matching the Yellow Path degrees evenly.
translations.idiomatic: At the two solstices, decrease one quarter, matching the ecliptic degrees evenly.

sentences.zh: 故推極其數，引而伸之，每氣移一候。

translations.literal: Therefore projecting the extreme numbers, extending and stretching them, each qi shifts one pentad.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore projecting the extreme numbers and extending them, each qi shifts one pentad.

sentences.zh: 月道所差，增損九分之一，七十二候而九道究矣。

translations.literal: The moon path's discrepancy increases and decreases one ninth; seventy-two pentads and the nine paths are complete.
translations.idiomatic: The lunar path discrepancy increases and decreases one ninth; after seventy-two pentads the nine paths are complete.

sentences.zh: 凡月交一終，退前所交一度及餘八萬九千七百七十三分度之四萬二千五百三少半，積二百二十一月及分七千七百五十三，而交道周天矣。

translations.literal: Whenever the moon completes one nodal cycle, it retreats one degree from the prior node and remainder eighty-nine thousand seven hundred seventy-three parts, four parts in forty-two thousand five hundred three and a little more than half a degree; accumulated two hundred twenty-one months and remainder seven thousand seven hundred fifty-three parts, and the nodal path completes heaven's circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the moon completes one nodal cycle, it retreats one degree from the prior node plus remainder 89,773 parts, 4 parts in 42,503 and a little more than half a degree; accumulated 221 months and remainder 7,753 parts, and the nodal path completes heaven's circuit.

sentences.zh: 因而半之，將九年而九道終。

translations.literal: Halving this, in about nine years the nine paths end.
translations.idiomatic: Halving this, in about nine years the nine paths complete.

sentences.zh: 以四象考之，各據合朔所交，入七十二候，則其八道之行也，以朔交為交初，望交為交中。

translations.literal: Examining by the four images, each according to conjunction new moon's meeting, entering seventy-two pentads—then the eight paths' courses: take new-moon node as node beginning, full-moon node as node mid.
translations.idiomatic: Examining by the four images, each from conjunction new moon's meeting, entering seventy-two pentads—the eight paths' courses take the new-moon node as node beginning and the full-moon node as node mid.

sentences.zh: 若交初在冬至初候而入陰曆，則行青道。

translations.literal: If node beginning at winter solstice's initial pentad enters the yin calendar, then follows the Green Path.
translations.idiomatic: If the node beginning at the winter solstice's initial pentad enters the yin calendar, the moon follows the Green Path.

sentences.zh: 又十三日七十六分日之四十六，至交中得所衝之宿，變入陽曆，亦行青道。

translations.literal: Again thirteen days and forty-six parts in seventy-six days, reaching node mid at the opposed lodge, changing to enter the yang calendar, also following the Green Path.
translations.idiomatic: Again thirteen days and forty-six seventy-sixths, reaching node mid at the opposed lodge, changing to enter the yang calendar, also following the Green Path.

sentences.zh: 若交初入陽曆，則白道也。

translations.literal: If node beginning first enters the yang calendar, then the White Path.
translations.idiomatic: If the node beginning first enters the yang calendar, it is the White Path.

sentences.zh: 故考交初所入，而周天之度可知。

translations.literal: Therefore examining node beginning's entry, heaven's circuit degrees can be known.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore examining the node beginning's entry, heaven's circuit degrees can be known.

sentences.zh: 若望交在冬至初候，則減十三日四十六分，視大雪初候陰陽曆而正其行也。

translations.literal: If full-moon node at winter solstice's initial pentad, then subtract thirteen days forty-six parts, viewing Great Cold's initial pentad yin-yang calendar to correct its course.
translations.idiomatic: If the full-moon node falls at the winter solstice's initial pentad, subtract thirteen days and forty-six parts, viewing Great Cold's initial pentad yin-yang calendar to correct its course.

sentences.zh: 其十晷漏中星略例曰：

translations.literal: The tenth, the summary of principles on gnomon shadows, clepsydra graduations, and culminating stars, says:
translations.idiomatic: The tenth section, the summary of principles on gnomon shadows, clepsydra graduations, and culminating stars, states:

sentences.zh: 日行有南北，晷漏有長短。

translations.literal: The sun's course has south and north; gnomon shadows and clepsydra graduations have long and short.
translations.idiomatic: The sun's course has south and north; gnomon shadows and clepsydra graduations have long and short.

sentences.zh: 然二十四氣晷差徐疾不同者，句股使然也。

translations.literal: Yet the twenty-four qi gnomon differences' slow and swift differ because of right triangle and leg—
translations.idiomatic: Yet the twenty-four qi gnomon differences vary in speed because of right triangle and leg—

sentences.zh: 直規中則差遲，與句股數齊則差急。

translations.literal: straight rule at center then difference slow; when equal to right triangle and leg numbers then difference swift.
translations.idiomatic: with the straight rule at center the difference is slow; when equal to the right triangle and leg numbers it is swift.

sentences.zh: 隨辰極高下，所遇不同，如黃道刻漏。

translations.literal: Following the pole's height and depth, what is encountered differs, like the ecliptic clepsydra graduations.
translations.idiomatic: Following the pole's height and depth, what is encountered differs, like the ecliptic clepsydra graduations.

sentences.zh: 此乃數之淺者，近代且猶未曉。

translations.literal: This is shallow in number—even recent times still do not understand it.
translations.idiomatic: This is shallow in number—even recent times still do not understand it.

sentences.zh: 今推黃道去極，與晷景、漏刻、昏距、中星四術返覆相求，消息同率，旋相為中，以合九服之變。

translations.literal: Now deriving the Yellow Path's departure from the pole, with gnomon shadow, clepsydra graduations, twilight distance, and culminating stars—the four methods reciprocally seek, message same rate, rotating as mid, to match the nine domains' change.
translations.idiomatic: Now deriving the ecliptic's departure from the pole with gnomon shadow, clepsydra graduations, twilight distance, and culminating stars—the four methods reciprocally seek, message same rate, rotating as mid, to match the nine domains' change.

sentences.zh: 其十一日蝕議曰：

translations.literal: The eleventh, the discourse on solar eclipses, says:
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh section, the discourse on solar eclipses, states:

sentences.zh: 小雅「十月之交，朔日辛卯」。

translations.literal: Minor Odes: 'In the tenth month's conjunction, new moon on Ximao.'
translations.idiomatic: Minor Odes: 'In the tenth month's conjunction, new moon on Ximao.'

sentences.zh: 虞𠠎以曆推之，在幽王六年。

translations.literal: Yu Xiao projected by calendar—it fell in You King year 6.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xiao projected by calendar—it fell in King You's sixth year.

sentences.zh: 開元曆定交分四萬三千四百二十九，入蝕限，加時在晝。

translations.literal: The Kaiyuan calendar fixes nodal fraction forty-three thousand four hundred twenty-nine, entering eclipse limit; added time in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: The Kaiyuan calendar fixes the nodal fraction at 43,429, entering the eclipse limit; added time in daytime.

sentences.zh: 交會而蝕，數之常也。

translations.literal: Nodes meeting and eclipsing is number's constant.
translations.idiomatic: Nodes meeting and eclipsing is the constant of number.

sentences.zh: 詩云：「彼月而食，則維其常。

translations.literal: The Odes say: 'That moon eclipsed—thus its constant.
translations.idiomatic: The Odes say: 'That moon eclipsed—that is its constant.

sentences.zh: 此日而食，于何不臧。

translations.literal: This sun eclipsed—how not ill.'
translations.idiomatic: This sun eclipsed—how is it not ill?'

sentences.zh: 」日，君道也，無朏魄之變；

translations.literal: The sun is the lord's way—no wax-wane change;
translations.idiomatic: The sun is the lord's way—no wax-wane change;

sentences.zh: 月，臣道也，遠日益明，近日益虧。

translations.literal: the moon is the minister's way—far from the sun daily brighter, near the sun daily more deficient.
translations.idiomatic: the moon is the minister's way—far from the sun it grows brighter daily, near the sun it wanes daily.

sentences.zh: 望與日軌相會，則徙而浸遠，遠極又徙而近交，所以著臣人之象也。

translations.literal: Full moon meeting the sun's track, then shifts and sinks far; at extreme distance shifts again toward near node—thereby showing minister and people's image.
translations.idiomatic: At full moon meeting the sun's track, it shifts and recedes; at extreme distance it shifts again toward near node—thereby showing the image of minister and people.

sentences.zh: 望而正於黃道，是謂臣干君明，則陽斯蝕之矣。

translations.literal: Full and straight on the Yellow Path—this is the minister confronting the lord's brightness, then yang is eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: Full and straight on the ecliptic—this is the minister confronting the lord's brightness, then yang is eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 朔而正於黃道，是謂臣壅君明，則陽為之蝕矣。

translations.literal: New moon straight on the Yellow Path—this is the minister blocking the lord's brightness, then yang is eclipsed for it.
translations.idiomatic: New moon straight on the ecliptic—this is the minister blocking the lord's brightness, then yang is eclipsed for it.

sentences.zh: 且十月之交，於曆當蝕，君子猶以為變，詩人悼之。

translations.literal: Moreover the tenth month's conjunction, by calendar ought to eclipse—yet gentlemen still took it as change, poets mourned it.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the tenth month's conjunction ought to eclipse by calendar—yet gentlemen still took it as change, poets mourned it.

sentences.zh: 然則古之太平，日不蝕，星不孛，蓋有之矣。

translations.literal: Then in antiquity's great peace, the sun did not eclipse, stars did not comet—perhaps there was such.
translations.idiomatic: Then in antiquity's great peace the sun did not eclipse and stars did not comet—perhaps there was such.

sentences.zh: 若過至未分，月或變行而避之；

translations.literal: If past solstice not yet divided, the moon perhaps changed course to avoid it;
translations.idiomatic: If past solstice not yet divided, the moon perhaps changed course to avoid it;

sentences.zh: 或五星潛在日下，禦侮而救之；

translations.literal: or the five stars concealed beneath the sun, defending and rescuing;
translations.idiomatic: or the five stars concealed beneath the sun, defending and rescuing;

sentences.zh: 或涉交數淺，或在陽曆，陽盛陰微則不蝕；

translations.literal: or nodal depth shallow, or in the yang calendar—yang abundant yin slight then no eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: or nodal depth shallow, or in the yang calendar—yang abundant and yin slight then no eclipse;

sentences.zh: 或德之休明，而有小眚焉，則天為之隱，雖交而不蝕。

translations.literal: or virtue bright and excellent, yet small blemish—then heaven hides it; though nodes meet, no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: or virtue bright and excellent yet small blemish—then heaven hides it; though nodes meet, no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 此四者，皆德教之所由生也。

translations.literal: These four all arise from virtue and teaching.
translations.idiomatic: These four all arise from virtue and teaching.

sentences.zh: 四序之中，分同道，至相過，交而有蝕，則天道之常。

translations.literal: Within the four seasons, equinoxes same path, solstices pass each other—nodes meeting with eclipse is heaven's way's constant.
translations.idiomatic: Within the four seasons, equinoxes share a path and solstices pass each other—nodes meeting with eclipse is heaven's constant way.

sentences.zh: 如劉歆、賈逵，皆近古大儒，豈不知軌道所交，朔望同術哉？

translations.literal: Like Liu Xin, Jia Kui—all near-ancient great ru—how could they not know tracks' meeting, new and full moons same method?
translations.idiomatic: Like Liu Xin and Jia Kui—all near-ancient great ru—how could they not know tracks' meeting and new and full moons' same method?

sentences.zh: 以日蝕非常，故闕而不論。

translations.literal: Because solar eclipse is not regular, therefore omitted and not discussed.
translations.idiomatic: Because solar eclipse is not regular, they omitted it and did not discuss it.

sentences.zh: 黃初已來，治曆者始課日蝕疎密，及張子信而益詳。

translations.literal: From Huangchu onward, calendar makers began gauging solar eclipse density; from Zhang Zixin it grew more detailed.
translations.idiomatic: From Huangchu onward calendar makers began gauging solar eclipse density; from Zhang Zixin it grew more detailed.

sentences.zh: 劉焯、張冑玄之徒自負其術，謂日月皆可以密率求，是專於曆紀者也。

translations.literal: Liu Chuo, Zhang Zouxuan and their kind prided themselves on their methods, saying sun and moon both can be sought by dense rates—this specializes in calendar records.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chuo, Zhang Zouxuan and their kind prided themselves on their methods, saying sun and moon both can be sought by dense rates—this specializes in calendar records alone.

sentences.zh: 以戊寅、麟德曆推春秋日蝕，大最皆入蝕限。

translations.literal: Using Wuyin and Lindé calendars to project Spring and Autumn solar eclipses, mostly all enter eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: Using the Wuyin and Lindé calendars to project Spring and Autumn solar eclipses, most all enter the eclipse limit.

sentences.zh: 於曆應蝕而春秋不書者尚多，則日蝕必在交限，其入限者不必盡蝕。

translations.literal: Where calendar ought to eclipse yet Spring and Autumn does not record, still many—then solar eclipse must be at node limit, yet entering limit need not all eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Where the calendar ought to eclipse yet Spring and Autumn does not record, still many—solar eclipse must be at the node limit, yet entering the limit need not always eclipse.

sentences.zh: 開元十二年七月戊午朔，於曆當蝕半強，自交趾至于朔方，候之不蝕。

translations.literal: Kaiyuan year 12, seventh month Wuwu new moon—by calendar ought to eclipse more than half; from Jiaozhi to Shuofang, observing—it did not eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyuan 12, seventh month Wuwu new moon—by calendar ought to eclipse more than half; from Jiaozhi to Shuofang, observing—it did not eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十三年十二月庚戌朔，於曆當蝕太半，時東封泰山，還次梁、宋間，皇帝徹饍，不舉樂，不蓋，素服，日亦不蝕。

translations.literal: Year 13, twelfth month Gengxu new moon—by calendar ought to eclipse more than three quarters; then eastward feng at Mount Tai, returning halted between Liang and Song—the emperor withdrew feast, raised no music, used no canopy, wore plain robes—the sun also did not eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Year 13, twelfth month Gengxu new moon—by calendar ought to eclipse more than three quarters; then the eastern feng at Mount Tai, returning halted between Liang and Song—the emperor withdrew the feast, raised no music, used no canopy, wore plain robes—the sun also did not eclipse.

sentences.zh: 時羣臣與八荒君長之來助祭者，降物以需，不可勝數，皆奉壽稱慶，肅然神服。

translations.literal: Then ministers and eight directions' lordlings coming to assist sacrifice, tribute objects awaited, beyond counting—all offered longevity, proclaimed celebration, reverently awed by spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Then ministers and lordlings from the eight directions coming to assist sacrifice, tribute objects awaited beyond counting—all offered longevity, proclaimed celebration, reverently awed by spirit.

sentences.zh: 雖算術乖舛，不宜如此，然後知德之動天，不俟終日矣。

translations.literal: Though arithmetic strayed and erred, it ought not be thus—yet afterward knew virtue moves heaven, not waiting a full day.
translations.idiomatic: Though arithmetic strayed and erred, it ought not be thus—yet afterward one knew virtue moves heaven, not waiting a full day.

sentences.zh: 若因開元二蝕，曲變交限而從之，則差者益多。

translations.literal: If because of Kaiyuan's two eclipses, bending node limits to follow, then discrepancies grow more.
translations.idiomatic: If because of Kaiyuan's two eclipses one bends node limits to follow, discrepancies grow more.

sentences.zh: 自開元治曆，史官每歲較節氣中晷，因檢加時小餘，雖大數有常，然亦與時推移，每歲不等。

translations.literal: Since Kaiyuan calendar governance, historiographers each year compared seasonal node midday gnomon, thereby checking added-time small remainder—though the great number has constant, yet it shifts with time, unequal each year.
translations.idiomatic: Since Kaiyuan calendar governance, historiographers each year compared seasonal node midday gnomon, thereby checking added-time small remainder—though the great number is constant, yet it shifts with time, unequal each year.

sentences.zh: 晷變而長，則日行黃道南；

translations.literal: Gnomon change lengthening—then sun follows Yellow Path south;
translations.idiomatic: Gnomon change lengthening—then the sun follows the ecliptic south;

sentences.zh: 晷變而短，則日行黃道北。

translations.literal: gnomon change shortening—then sun follows Yellow Path north.
translations.idiomatic: gnomon change shortening—then the sun follows the ecliptic north.

sentences.zh: 行而南，則陰曆之交也或失；

translations.literal: Course south—then yin calendar's nodes perhaps miss;
translations.idiomatic: Course south—then the yin calendar's nodes may miss;

sentences.zh: 行而北，則陽曆之交也或失。

translations.literal: course north—then yang calendar's nodes perhaps miss.
translations.idiomatic: course north—then the yang calendar's nodes may miss.

sentences.zh: 日在黃道之中，且猶有變，況月行九道乎！

translations.literal: Sun in Yellow Path's midst, yet still has change—how much more moon following nine paths!
translations.idiomatic: The sun in the ecliptic's midst still has change—how much more the moon following nine paths!

sentences.zh: 杜預云：「日月動物，雖行度有大量，不能不小有盈縮。

translations.literal: Du Yu said: 'Sun and moon are moving things—though course degrees have great measure, cannot but have small expansion and contraction.
translations.idiomatic: Du Yu said: 'Sun and moon are moving bodies—though course degrees have great measure, they cannot but have small expansion and contraction.

sentences.zh: 故有雖交會而不蝕者，或有頻交而蝕者。

translations.literal: Therefore though nodes meet yet no eclipse, or sometimes frequent meetings yet eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore though nodes meet yet no eclipse, or sometimes frequent meetings yet eclipse.

sentences.zh: 」是也。

translations.literal: ' So it is.
translations.idiomatic: ' So it is.

sentences.zh: 故較曆必稽古史，虧蝕深淺、加時朓朒陰陽，其數相叶者，反覆相求，由曆數之中，以合辰象之變；

translations.literal: Therefore comparing calendars must examine ancient histories—deficiency eclipse depth, added time wax-wane yin-yang, numbers matching leaf together, reciprocally seek, from calendar numbers' midst to match star image's change;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore comparing calendars must examine ancient histories—eclipse depth, added time wax-wane yin-yang, numbers matching together, reciprocally seek, from calendar numbers' midst to match star image's change;

sentences.zh: 觀辰象之變，反求曆數之中。

translations.literal: view star image's change, inversely seek calendar numbers' midst.
translations.idiomatic: view star image's change, inversely seek calendar numbers' midst.

sentences.zh: 類其所同，而中可知矣；

translations.literal: Classify what is same—then mid can be known;
translations.idiomatic: Classify what is same—then mid can be known;

sentences.zh: 辨其所異，而變可知矣。

translations.literal: discriminate what differs—then change can be known.
translations.idiomatic: discriminate what differs—then change can be known.

sentences.zh: 其循度則合于曆，失行則合于占。

translations.literal: Following degrees then matches calendar; losing course then matches prognostication.
translations.idiomatic: Following degrees then matches calendar; losing course then matches prognostication.

sentences.zh: 占道順成，常執中以追變；

translations.literal: Prognostication's way follows completion, constantly holding mid to pursue change;
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication's way follows completion, constantly holding mid to pursue change;

sentences.zh: 曆道逆數，常執中以俟變。

translations.literal: calendar's way reverses number, constantly holding mid to await change.
translations.idiomatic: calendar's way reverses number, constantly holding mid to await change.

sentences.zh: 知此之說者，天道如視諸掌。

translations.literal: Knowing this discourse—heaven's way like viewing in the palm.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing this discourse—heaven's way is like viewing in the palm.

sentences.zh: 略例曰：舊曆考日蝕淺深，皆自張子信所傳，云積候所得，而未曉其然也。

translations.literal: Summary of principles says: Old calendars examining solar eclipse depth all from Zhang Zixin's transmission, saying accumulated pentads obtained—yet not understanding its thus.
translations.idiomatic: Summary of principles says: Old calendars examining solar eclipse depth all from Zhang Zixin's transmission, saying accumulated pentads obtained—yet not understanding why.

sentences.zh: 以圓儀度日月之徑，乃以月徑之半減入交初限一度半，餘為闇虛半徑。

translations.literal: By circular instrument measure sun and moon's diameter—then by half moon diameter subtract from entering node initial limit one and a half degrees, remainder is dark void half-radius.
translations.idiomatic: By circular instrument measure sun and moon's diameter—then by half moon diameter subtract from entering node initial limit one and a half degrees, remainder is dark void half-radius.

sentences.zh: 以月去黃道每度差數，令二徑相掩，以驗蝕分，以所入日遲疾乘徑，為泛所用刻數，大率去交不及三度，即月行沒在闇虛，皆入既限。

translations.literal: By moon's departure from Yellow Path each degree difference number, make two diameters mask each other, to verify eclipse fraction; by entered sun slow-swift multiply diameter, as general used ke number—broadly, departure from node less than three degrees, then moon's course submerged in dark void, all enter full-eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: By the moon's departure from the ecliptic each degree difference, make two diameters mask each other to verify eclipse fraction; by entered sun slow-swift multiply diameter as general ke number—broadly, departure from node less than three degrees, the moon's course submerged in dark void, all enter full-eclipse limit.

sentences.zh: 又半日月之徑，減春分入交初限相去度數，餘為斜射所差。

translations.literal: Also half sun-moon diameter, subtract spring equinox entering node initial limit mutual distance degrees, remainder is oblique projection's difference.
translations.idiomatic: Also half sun-moon diameter, subtract spring equinox entering node initial limit mutual distance degrees, remainder is oblique projection's difference.

sentences.zh: 乃考差數，以立既限。

translations.literal: Then examine difference number, to establish full-eclipse limit.
translations.idiomatic: Then examine difference number to establish full-eclipse limit.

sentences.zh: 而優游進退於二度中間，亦令二徑相掩，以知日蝕分數。

translations.literal: Yet leisurely advancing and retreating within two degrees' midst, also make two diameters mask each other, to know solar eclipse fraction.
translations.idiomatic: Yet leisurely advancing and retreating within two degrees' midst, also make two diameters mask each other to know solar eclipse fraction.

sentences.zh: 月徑踰既限之南，則雖在陰曆，而所虧類同外道，斜望使然也。

sentences.zh: 遇其所好之星，則趣之行疾，捨之行遲。

translations.literal: Meeting stars they favor, then hasten course swift, leaving course slow.
translations.idiomatic: Meeting stars they favor, then hasten course swift, leaving course slow.

sentences.zh: 張子信曆辰星應見不見術，晨夕去日前後四十六度內，十八度外，有木、火、土、金一星者見，無則不見。

translations.literal: Zhang Zixin calendar Chronogram Star ought appear not appear method—dawn and evening departure sun before and after forty-six degrees within, eighteen degrees without, having Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal one star then appear, none then not appear.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zixin calendar Chronogram Star ought appear not appear method—dawn and evening departure sun before and after forty-six degrees within, eighteen degrees without, having Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal one star then appear, none then not appear.

sentences.zh: 張冑玄曆，朔望在交限，有星伏在日下，木、土去見十日外，火去見四十日外，金去見二十二日外者，並不加減差，皆精氣相感使然。

translations.literal: Zhang Zouxuan calendar, new and full moons at node limit, having star concealed beneath sun, Wood and Earth departure appearance ten days without, Fire departure appearance forty days without, Metal departure appearance twenty-two days without—all not add subtract discrepancy, all essence qi mutual sensing makes so.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zouxuan calendar, new and full moons at node limit, having star concealed beneath sun, Wood and Earth departure appearance ten days without, Fire departure appearance forty days without, Metal departure appearance twenty-two days without—all not add subtract discrepancy, all essence qi mutual sensing makes so.

sentences.zh: 夫日月所以著尊卑不易之象，五星所以示政教從時之義。

translations.literal: Sun and moon thereby show nobility and baseness unchanging image, five stars thereby show governance and teaching following time's meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and moon thereby show nobility and baseness unchanging image, five stars thereby show governance and teaching following time's meaning.

sentences.zh: 故日月之失行也，微而少；

translations.literal: Therefore sun and moon's lost course, subtle and few;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore sun and moon's lost course, subtle and few;

sentences.zh: 五星之失行也，著而多。

translations.literal: five stars' lost course, manifest and many.
translations.idiomatic: five stars' lost course, manifest and many.

sentences.zh: 今略考常數，以課疎密。

translations.literal: Now briefly examine constant numbers, to gauge density and sparsity.
translations.idiomatic: Now briefly examine constant numbers, to gauge density and sparsity.

sentences.zh: 略例曰：其入氣加減，亦自張子信始，後人莫不遵用之。

translations.literal: Summary of principles says: Its entering qi increase decrease, also from Zhang Zixin began—later people none not respect and use it.
translations.idiomatic: Summary of principles says: Its entering qi increase decrease, also from Zhang Zixin began—later people none not respect and use it.

sentences.zh: 原始要終，多有不叶。

translations.literal: Origin and end, mostly not leaf together.
translations.idiomatic: Origin and end, mostly not leaf together.

sentences.zh: 今較麟德曆，熒惑、太白見伏行度過與不及，熒惑凡四十八事，太白二十一事。

translations.literal: Now compare Lindé calendar, Sparkling Deluder and Great White appearance conceal course degrees passing and not reaching—Sparkling Deluder altogether forty-eight affairs, Great White twenty-one affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Now compare Lindé calendar, Sparkling Deluder and Great White appearance conceal course degrees passing and not reaching—Sparkling Deluder altogether forty-eight affairs, Great White twenty-one affairs.

sentences.zh: 餘星所差，蓋細不足考。

translations.literal: Remaining stars' discrepancy, broadly fine not worth examining.
translations.idiomatic: Remaining stars' discrepancy, broadly fine not worth examining.

sentences.zh: 且盈縮之行，宜與四象潛合，而二十四氣加減不均。

translations.literal: Moreover expansion-contraction's course, ought with four images secretly combine—yet twenty-four qi increase decrease not equal.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover expansion-contraction's course, ought with four images secretly combine—yet twenty-four qi increase decrease not equal.

sentences.zh: 更推易數而正之，又各立歲差，以究五精運周二十八舍之變。

translations.literal: Again push Changes numbers and correct—also each establish annual precession, to investigate five essences' circuit Zhou twenty-eight lodges' change.
translations.idiomatic: Again push Changes numbers and correct—also each establish annual precession, to investigate five essences' circuit Zhou twenty-eight lodges' change.

sentences.zh: 較史官所記，歲星二十七事，熒惑二十八事，鎮星二十一事，太白二十二事，辰星二十四事，開元曆課皆第一云。

translations.literal: Compare historiography records—Year Star twenty-seven affairs, Sparkling Deluder twenty-eight affairs, Queller Star twenty-one affairs, Great White twenty-two affairs, Chronogram Star twenty-four affairs—Kaiyuan calendar examination all ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: Compare historiography records—Year Star twenty-seven affairs, Sparkling Deluder twenty-eight affairs, Queller Star twenty-one affairs, Great White twenty-two affairs, Chronogram Star twenty-four affairs—Kaiyuan calendar examination all ranked first.

sentences.zh: 至肅宗時，山人韓穎上言大衍曆或誤。

translations.literal: To Emperor Suzong's time, mountain man Han Ying submitted saying Dayan calendar sometimes error.
translations.idiomatic: To Emperor Suzong's time, mountain man Han Ying submitted saying Dayan calendar sometimes error.

sentences.zh: 帝疑之，以穎為太子宮門郎，直司天臺。

translations.literal: Emperor doubted it, made Ying Crown Prince palace gate gentleman, direct Heavenly Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor doubted it, made Ying Crown Prince palace gate gentleman, direct Heavenly Terrace.

sentences.zh: 又損益其術，每節增二日，更名至德曆，起乾元元年用之，訖上元三年。

translations.literal: Again increase decrease its method, each node add two days, rename Zhide calendar, starting Qianyuan year 1 use it, ending Shangyuan year 3.
translations.idiomatic: Again increase decrease its method, each node add two days, rename Zhide calendar, starting Qianyuan 1 use it, ending Shangyuan 3.
